concepts.label: Add Search to Your Application (landing/overview page for the Search Service)

notable_absence.finding: This landing/overview page for the entire Search Service makes no mention of RBAC roles/privileges at all (not even a pointer to where they're documented), despite create-quick-index.md later in the same tree requiring the 'Search Admin' role. A reader starting here would not learn that a role is needed until they reach a specific task page.

competency_questions_addressed: What is the Search Service and what can it be used for?
